subject: Geopolitics
title: Ukraine's Information Victory
description: A short lesson to help you apply Ukraine's Information Victory.

hook.text: Zelensky posted a selfie video from Kyiv streets on night one of Russia's invasion. 'We are here.' The world rallied.

buildup.text: Ukraine used social media, memes, and direct appeals to win global sympathy. Truth was its sharpest weapon.

discovery.text: Russia's disinformation failed abroad because Ukrainian firsthand footage flooded platforms.

twist.text: Inside Russia, state media controlled the narrative. Most Russians believed Ukraine attacked first.

climax.text: Ukraine showed that a smaller nation can win the info war with authenticity. Truth scales when platforms allow it.

punchline.text: A selfie video outperformed a propaganda machine.

quiz.question: How did Ukraine win the international information war?
options: By censoring all Russian content globally
Through authentic first-person footage and direct appeals
By hiring the world's largest PR firm
